en.headline: Police run multi-agency anti-burglary operation across New Territories South
en.dek: Officers from New Territories South, marine police and the Government Flying Service conducted land, sea and air patrols over two days, deploying drones for high-altitude checks near housing estates.
body: Police in New Territories South launched a two-day multi-agency anti-burglary operation codenamed Tiger General on Friday and Saturday, aiming to strengthen prevention and detection of break-ins ahead of the year-end period.

The operation involved the regional tactical unit, emergency units, the drone team, the police dog unit, the regional crime prevention office, district community relations teams, uniformed patrol teams and special teams. Marine Region provided sea support while the Government Flying Service assisted with aerial observation.

Officers conducted high-profile patrols and searches at high-risk locations near housing estates, including hillsides, dense woodland and waterways. Roadblocks were set up at different times and places to stop and check suspicious people and vehicles.

Police said small drones were used for urban high-altitude patrols at night along waterfronts and around estates to improve overall crime prevention and response capabilities. The force said the deployment allowed more flexible use of frontline manpower and further supported the building of a smarter and safer community environment.

zh.headline: 新界南警方展開海陸空跨部門反爆竊行動
zh.dek: 新界南總區聯同水警及政府飛行服務隊一連兩日進行海陸空巡邏，並引入無人機在屋苑附近作高空監察。
body: 警方新界南總區於周五及周六展開一連兩日代號「虎將」的跨部門聯合反爆竊行動，旨在歲晚前加強打擊及預防區內爆竊罪案。
行動屬新界南總區大型聯合部署，參與單位包括機動部隊、衝鋒隊、無人機隊、警犬隊、總區防止罪案辦公室、各警區警民關係組、軍裝巡邏小隊及特遣隊。水警總區提供海上支援，政府飛行服務隊則協助空中觀察。
人員針對鄰近屋苑的山坡、密林及水路等高風險地點進行高調巡邏及搜查，並按策略於不同時段及地點設置路障，截查可疑人士及車輛。
警方表示，行動中引入小型無人機執行市區高空巡邏，於夜間在海濱及屋苑周邊操作，以提升整體防罪及應變能力。警方指透過應用無人機可更靈活調配前線警力，進一步促進建設智能、安全的社區環境。
